There is one honest road in, and it runs through Merlin keeper saker mark flown at the aerie: the toll is each saker is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger, paid where everyone can watch. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. A farm can rehearse the spiral and rehearse the onyx, but it cannot rehearse the vine, because a year will not rehearse.
